svg.aria-label: no-ai-slop. A pixel-art editor in a red beret runs along ruled paper and stomps four green slop blobs with a red pen: a plain one, a second, a trio of small ones and one with a question balloon. The editor collects two coins, 42 and 9, instead of striking them, and reaches a green finish flag. A scoreboard counts four blobs struck and two coins kept.
